newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Hindustan Zinc to set up power plant.
newsitem.headline: India's Hindustan Zinc to set up power plant.

text.p: India's state-run Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) and the Rajasthan State Mines and Minerals Ltd (RSMML) plan to set up a 100 megawatt power plant near Udaipur in the northwestern Rajasthan state, HZL said on Monday.

A statement from HZL's headquarters at Udaipur said the two companies had signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to set up the 3.3 billion-rupee ($92 million) project. The plant is likely to be operational in 1999, the statement said.

The two companies will form a joint venture for the purpose, with HZL holding 74 percent equity and RSMML the remaining 26 percent in a new company, the statement said. It do not say what fuel the proposed plant was to use.
